title: Senate approves OVP 2027 budget in one minute | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: Sara Duterte, Excise tax on coffee, Jensen Huang

blocks.text: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Senate OKs OVP 2027 budget in one minute

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte personally attends the Senate plenary deliberations on the Office of the Vice President’s proposed P785.24-million budget for 2027.

items: Excise tax on your coffee? House leader shuts down suggestion

blocks.text: House ways and means chairman Miro Quimbo shuts down the idea of imposing an excise tax on coffee.

items: Sandiganbayan suspends Pasay judge over bribery case

blocks.text: The anti-graft court Sandiganbayan orders the three-month preventive suspension of Pasay City Judge Albert Cansino for a direct bribery charge filed by the Office of the Ombudsman.

items: US officials divided over Chinese spying allegations following Jensen Huang’s return

blocks.text: Days after President Donald Trump declared Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was not a security threat, a question remains unanswered: Was the woman Huang had an affair with a Chinese spy?

items: Duran Duran guitarist and songwriter Andy Taylor dies at 65

blocks.text: The guitarist and songwriter for pop-rock band Duran Duran and a Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductee Andy Taylor passed away at the age of 65. – Rappler.com
